// NaN, infinities and signed zero are native real grouping keys.
let Events=datatable(Timestamp:datetime,Group:real,Marker:string) [
datetime(2026-01-01T00:00:00),real(nan),"match",
datetime(2026-01-01T00:01:00),real(nan),"match",
datetime(2026-01-01T00:00:00),real(+inf),"match",
datetime(2026-01-01T00:01:00),real(+inf),"match",
datetime(2026-01-01T00:00:00),real(-inf),"match",
datetime(2026-01-01T00:01:00),real(-inf),"match",
datetime(2026-01-01T00:00:00),real(-0.0),"match",
datetime(2026-01-01T00:01:00),real(+0.0),"match"
];
let Actual=(){
let SourceMatchArrivals = union (Events
| where Marker =~ "match"
| project EventTime_1 = todatetime(["Timestamp"]), GroupGroup = ["Group"])
| where isnotnull(EventTime_1) and isnotempty(GroupGroup)
| summarize SourceMatchCount = count() by EventTime_1, GroupGroup;
union (SourceMatchArrivals
| project GroupGroup, CountBoundaryTime = EventTime_1, CountBoundaryOrder = 0, SourceMatchDelta = SourceMatchCount),
(SourceMatchArrivals
| project GroupGroup, CountBoundaryTime = EventTime_1 + 5m, CountBoundaryOrder = 1, SourceMatchDelta = -SourceMatchCount)
// Arrivals evaluate before equal-time expirations; expirations never create matches.
| sort by GroupGroup asc, CountBoundaryTime asc, CountBoundaryOrder asc
| extend EventCount = row_cumsum(SourceMatchDelta, GroupGroup != prev(GroupGroup))
| where CountBoundaryOrder == 0
| where EventCount >= 1
| project WindowStart = CountBoundaryTime - 5m, WindowEnd = CountBoundaryTime, ["Group"] = GroupGroup, EventCount
};
let Expected=datatable(WindowEnd:datetime,EventCount:long) [datetime(2026-01-01T00:00:00),1,datetime(2026-01-01T00:01:00),2]
| extend Keys=dynamic(["nan","+inf","-inf","0"])
| mv-expand Group=Keys to typeof(string)
| project WindowEnd,EventCount,Group;
let Observed=Actual()|project WindowEnd,EventCount,Group=tostring(Group);
union (Expected | extend Delta=-1),(Observed | extend Delta=1)
| summarize Delta=sum(Delta) by WindowEnd,EventCount,Group
| where Delta!=0
